newsitem.title: USA: Astoria group holds 7 pct Eateries stake.
newsitem.headline: Astoria group holds 7 pct Eateries stake.

text.p: A group led by Astoria Capital Partners L.P. said Monday it holds a seven percent stake in Eateries Inc or 270,200 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net of 119,200 common shares bought between May 1 and Sept 9 at prices ranging from $3.085 to $5.875 per share.
The group bought the shares in the Oklahoma City, Ok. company for investment purposes, the filing said.
